title: Algerian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish featuring lamb kebabs marinated in a blend of spices and herbs.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, Algerian spice blend, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread lamb onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges and kisses (if using).
Let lamb rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve kebabs with your favorite sides, such as couscous or roasted vegetables.
